method: All original/rebuilt page pairs inspected after reconstruction, plus enlarged complex grammar, text geometry and dictionary examples. Two independent sets of six proofreading agents inspected originals and raw OCR; main adjudication compared their text and directly inspected source differences.
limitations: Closest embedded font substitution used for reconstructed print. Native text/font objects retained on 1,3,110,111,112.
Complex boxed endings, colored handwriting and morpheme notation remain original graphic fragments with corresponding Unicode text.
Very small photograph inscriptions can remain unreadable; original images preserved, no guessed text added.
Wiki lesson/question/table grouping remains an automatic candidate structure.
